method: Same-agent English/Marathi block-by-block close reading, reconstruction of the possible-world reading and Kripke frame conditions, verification of all S4 and S5 axioms, and exact formula, macro, controlled-token, identifier and reference comparison. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Material versus necessary conditionals; modal box and diamond operators; possible worlds and accessibility; intensional and extensional logic; provability, epistemic and temporal readings; and S4/S5 axiom systems with Kripke frame correspondences.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A materially true conditional can mislead when its wording suggests that the consequent would hold in every possible world where the antecedent holds. Modal propositional logic adds a box for necessity, while diamond abbreviates not-necessarily-not and expresses possibility; the same modality can extend predicate logic.
samples.checks: The antecedent/consequent distinction, trivial truth in the actual world, counterfactual force, possible-world reading, box formation rule and diamond abbreviation are retained.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A modal Kripke frame uses possible worlds with a binary accessibility relation, read as compatibility. Unlike one-world extensional semantics, intensional semantics needs a richer ontology. Reinterpreting the modalities yields provability, epistemic and temporal logics.
samples.checks: The move beyond partial orders, direction of R(p,q), actual-world contrast and all six operator readings are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: S4 contains the three displayed modal axioms and necessitation; S5 adds that possibility is necessarily possible. S4 corresponds to reflexive transitive accessibility, whereas S5 has universal accessibility, so necessity means truth in every world.
samples.checks: All four displayed formulas, the inference rule, logical-necessity qualification, soundness/completeness claim and both frame correspondences are retained.

source_observations: All formulas, macros, controlled tokens, identifiers and references match the frozen source exactly.
No exact authoritative Marathi modal-logic inventory was found in the bounded search, so मोडल and the transparent compounds in T264–T267 remain explicitly reviewable.
The translation uses वास्तविक अभिव्यंजन for material implication consistently with T117, avoiding the physical sense of भौतिक.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
The मोडल, प्राप्यता and आशयात्मक choices should receive specialist review.
No TeX reader build was run for this individual unit.
